## Bad event

An operation executes before a trusted audit PASS for the exact DIGEST of its content (and, if irreversible, an exact-digest approval), or executes twice, or after timeout/HALT. Content level: sc25_content_safe under Set.InjOn h over contents in the run (REVIEW-PACKET finding 3 closed; W3 = digest_only_executes_unaudited). Read "by X" as "by an operation carrying X's authenticated identity" (credential separation is a premise, not a theorem).
